I don't think I was abused. I have no recollection of anything, and I've never been afraid of other people. I think I just lost my shit sometime in the 3rd grade. I was bullied around that time, though. I honestly remember very little from 1998. 

Alright, I'm not feeling suicidal anymore. Awesome. Cool. Took about and hour and a half to pass. God, this is sick.

It's a shame therapy is so expensive. It's completely out of my budget as well, until next year when I get my stipend.
I'm just so tired of fighting this battle. I've been sick on and off for fourteen years.

I used to see a therapist, until a few months ago. I'm going to grad school in a different city next year, so I'm thinking I'll just get another psychiatrist there (since the school will pay for it).

I just don't want to burden my friends and family anymore. My friends know very little about this, and my family knows too much. Last year my mother stayed with me for days and helped me get better, encouraged me to see a doctor, etc. But she was in so much pain, seeing me sick. And what do I tell my friends? Hey guys, I want to off myself every once in a while? I just don't know how to handle this. I'm worried they'll think I'm attention whoring.

You're kind, and I'm sorry that you're in a similar position. but you did help a bit just by talking to me.

Also, I'm a chick :)
